name: 地域と検索の設定をまとめたクイック設定シート
prompt:
Edit Image 1 with a very small correction and preserve its current Japanese content, white palette, icon shapes, borders, dimensions and all positions. Return exactly a 366×540 panel. Image 1 controls the Japanese text, typography, palette and current arrangement. Image 2 controls only the source crop edge and the lower CTA overlap/crop. Image 3 controls only the approved green gradient.

The only needed correction is at the bottom: Image 1 currently leaves a narrow white footer below the green 「すべての設定」 CTA. Extend the same CTA down to the 366×540 crop boundary so the gradient button is visibly cut by the bottom image edge exactly like Image 2. The final pixel row must remain button green; no white footer below it. Preserve the CTA's current left/right margins, radius, text, gradient direction, and top edge. Keep the safe-search label/description partly covered by the CTA as in Image 2. Do not move other elements or change card, header, or row spacing.

Keep all surfaces white with fine neutral borders and all utility icons slate. Keep the selected third theme glyph and CTA in the exact gradient #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E. No gray/mint tint, shadow, glow, added content, or extra whitespace.
reviewNotes: Actual-size visual review at 366x540 against the original source crop. White surfaces and fine neutral borders, slate utility icons, gradient selected theme and CTA. CTA reaches the cropped bottom edge without a footer gap. Candidate-level review only; owner approval, native editability and app implementation are not established.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
